title: Resident Terms of Service — Utility Pass-Through Service Schedule, Account Opening and Service Start
content:
**1. Schedule fixed by the site.** The service schedule of a Utility Pass-Through Service account is fixed by the site, not chosen by the resident: it is the schedule whose entry gate lists the community and section of the site, the section being the letter before the hyphen in the site number.

**2. Signed lease.** A utility account is opened only for a lease that has been signed (active). This is checked against the company's lease record — the lease, its status, its community and its site number — before the account is opened.

**3. Service start.** Service starts on the lease move-in date with an opening read on every submetered service, and the first statement prorates fixed charges from that date.

**4. Schedule changes.** A schedule changes only when Hearthstone changes the community's utility infrastructure; a resident request to move to a different schedule, or to take service directly from the public utility, is not available.

**5. Replacement meters.** A replacement meter is installed only after a meter test finds the old meter outside tolerance, and its serial number replaces the old one on the account.

## Entry gates of the schedules

| Community | Sections | Service schedule |
|---|---|---|
| Palmetto Shores | A, B, C | Flat-Rate Water, Sewer & Trash Schedule |
| Palmetto Shores | D, E, F | Submetered Water & Sewer Schedule |
| Willow Bend Estates | all | Submetered Water & Sewer Schedule |
| Bluebonnet Ridge | all | Submetered Water Schedule |
| Cedar Hollow | all | Submetered Water, Sewer & Natural Gas Schedule |
| Conestoga Meadows | all | Submetered Water, Sewer & Propane Schedule |
| Saguaro Vista | all | Submetered Electric, Water & Sewer Schedule |

## Applying the terms (hypothetical sites)

| Site | Section read from the site number | Schedule |
|---|---|---|
| Palmetto Shores, site B-27 | B | Flat-Rate Water, Sewer & Trash Schedule |
| Palmetto Shores, site E-114 | E | Submetered Water & Sewer Schedule |
| Cedar Hollow, site C-08 | C (all sections) | Submetered Water, Sewer & Natural Gas Schedule |

**Q. May a resident at Palmetto Shores section B ask to be moved to the submetered schedule used in section D?** No. The schedule is fixed by the site, and a resident request to move to a different schedule is not available.

**Q. May a resident take water directly from the public utility instead?** No; that request is not available either.

**Q. A residency application has been approved but the lease is not yet signed. Is a utility account opened?** No. An account is opened only for a lease that has been signed (active).

**Q. When does a new account's first statement begin charging fixed charges?** From the lease move-in date, prorated, with opening reads taken that day on every submetered service.
